The '''Malachor Depths''' were a series of underground passageways and caverns located beneath the surface of [[Malachor V]]. [[Meetra Surik]] walked through the Malachor Depths on her way to the [[Trayus Academy]] during the [[Battle of Malachor]]. Like the surface, the Malachor Depths contained wreckages of the [[Battle of Malachor V]] and was home to [[storm beast]]s.<ref name="TSL" />
